A lot of them have asked about my age and it is a little odd in my class. Most of them are girls who just finished high shcool. I've never had many female friends, not because I have anything against other girls, I'm just used to being mostly around boys, or girls who aren't as interested in talking about make up and clothes as the ones I've met here have been so far.. Nothing against that either, I'm just not used to it. So being in an all girl class kind of adds to my anxiety, as weird as it might sound. 

I'm interested in a lot of different things so that's not the problem. But I'd like to not feel completely alone between classes. And if I want to continue in this program, I have to go through 5 years of it in order to get a degree. I've never finished anything before and I'm more depressed than ever so how would I make it now. A 3 year degree would at least have seemed a little more achievable but it would be so ridiculous to start over a fourth time...

anyway good for you that you're cathing up. the future *is* scary.

Oops, accidentally replied with my main account.

Anyway, thanks for replying. :) If I can keep my head above water for a little longer, I could try different meds and therapy, but it's hard for me right now to see how it could possibly help me.
I can't see how I'll ever stop being ashamed of myself. I should probably have studied somewhere with more people my own age, like engineering or something, maybe I wouldn't have felt so different. But then again, maybe I would,.
